title: Houston sends Ky images at night about the film

tellings.quote: and I said I wrote Katie and I said does H is does Houston send me images at night about the movie can you ask him if he just did that and she wrote back and she asked Houston and Houston said yes I do s Kai Images

plain: The documentary maker Ky Dickens says that in 2024 she wrote to a woman named Katie to ask whether Houston, one of the people in her film about children said to read minds, was sending her images at night about the movie. She says Katie asked Houston, and he answered yes, he does send Ky images. Dickens tells it as her own experience, and it would suggest a mind-to-mind link at a distance.
